# EmptyState

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:empty-state` · Kerf UI · component · Feedback

## When to use

Actionable empty and busy content states.

- Explain absent or busy content and offer an optional recovery action.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for an inline update or transient success.

**Alternatives:**

- [StateBanner](./state-banner.md) (nearest)
- [Toast](./wa-toast.md) (prefer-over)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/empty-state` — exports `EmptyState`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/empty-state` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/empty-state.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/empty-state`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiempty-state) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `empty-content`, `busy-content`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md), [LoadingSpinner](./loading-spinner.md).

Zones (a zone is bound to JSX only through its listed prop; never assume the zone id is a prop):

- `icon` — JSX prop `icon`; accepts `dormant-decoration`; 0–1.
- `action` — JSX prop `action`; accepts `control`; 0–1.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** empty/busy policy; recovery action; copy.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: self · padding: self (layout role: feedback). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Busy state uses aria-busy; the illustration never supplies the only label.

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-empty-state`, `kui-empty-state__action`, `kui-empty-state__icon`.

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-neutral-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-text`, `--kui-empty-state-foreground`, `--kui-empty-state-title`, `--kui-font-l`, `--kui-font-s`, `--kui-space-xl`, `--kui-space-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.
